description: Latest paper-account catalog status and append-only event monitoring. PostgreSQL is an operator projection; the local paper ledger remains the rebuildable source of truth.

panels.description: One row per registered paper account. A latest event is shown when the local ledger has published an event envelope.

targets.rawSql: SELECT account_id::text AS account_id, name, strategy_name, strategy_version, status, approval_mode, last_event_sequence, last_event_session, last_event_type, last_nav_base::double precision AS nav_base, last_cash_base::double precision AS cash_base, last_positions_value_base::double precision AS positions_value_base, last_event_at FROM paper_account_status ORDER BY name

panels.title: Paper account status

panels.description: Valuation events emitted by the paper event envelope. Missing points mean no valuation has been cataloged; they are not filled with synthetic values.

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_at AS time, account_id::text AS metric, nav_base::double precision AS value FROM paper_account_events WHERE event_type = 'valuation' AND $__timeFilter(event_at) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Paper NAV by account

panels.description: Event-type counts make approvals, rejections, halts, fills, corporate actions, and reconciliation activity visible without turning the dashboard into the full replay ledger.

targets.rawSql: SELECT account_id::text AS account_id, event_type, count(*)::double precision AS events, max(event_at) AS last_event_at FROM paper_account_events GROUP BY account_id, event_type ORDER BY events DESC, account_id, event_type
